API ReferenceBusiness Insights APIReport ConfigurationsGet Report Configurations (Custom Apps)
Get Report Configurations (Custom Apps)
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/bi/api/v1/reports/:report_type

Get Report Configurations along with their associated Custom Apps. Currently only report_type "customapps" is supported.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
report_type
string
REQUIRED

Possible values: [customapps]

Type of report. Currently only "customapps" is supported.

QUERY PARAMETERS
id
int32

Optional report configuration ID to retrieve.

Responses
​
200
400
401
403
405
429
500

Report configurations retrieved successfully.

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
backfillOverview
backfillUsers
scheduledOverview
scheduledUsers
SCHEMA
Array [
id
int32
report_schema
string[]

Optional list of fields to include in the report output. The available fields depend on the selected sub_type: For OVERVIEW: application_name, access_path, uniqueuserscount, transactions For USERS: application_name, access_path, user_email_id, transactions, login_date

delivery_information
object[]
schedule_params
object
backfill_params
object
name
string
REQUIRED
sub_type
string
REQUIRED

Possible values: [OVERVIEW, USERS]

enabled
boolean
Default value: true
custom_ids
int32[]
REQUIRED

Currently supports exactly one Custom App reference ID. Multiple values will be rejected.

Possible values: >= 1, <= 1

status
string

Possible values: [ACCEPTED, SCHEDULED_SUCCESS, SCHEDULED_FAILED, FAILED, SUCCESS, IN_PROGRESS, UPDATED]

nextRuntime
int64

Next runtime timestamp (seconds since epoch).

object[]
